message.content: Halo! Untuk memeriksa ketersediaan ukuran XS, saya perlu memastikan Anda sudah masuk ke akun Anda. Bisakah Anda memberikan nama pengguna dan kata sandi Anda (atau mengautentikasi terlebih dahulu) agar saya dapat memeriksa status stok? Jika Anda tidak ingin berbagi kredensial di sini, silakan masuk melalui portal resmi kami dan beri tahu saya jika ada pertanyaan lain.
message.reasoning: The user says: "Hallo, ukuran XS tidak ada ya?" which is Indonesian: "Hello, size XS is not available, right?" They likely want to check availability of XS size. We need to authenticate? The tool is user_authentication_login. But we don't have username/password. The user didn't provide credentials. So we cannot call the function. We can respond asking for credentials or say we can't proceed. Probably ask for login.
